title: CDAD guard recorded trace (003-003 trace-v1)
description: Recorded trace consumed by `cdad_guard classify`. Argument canonicalization is the recorder's responsibility: `entries[].args` must be recorded already-canonicalized (only stable fields). The guard hashes args as recorded and does not canonicalize them (003-003 B3b). An absent or non-string `progress_token` is an unobserved progress signal and must not yield a frozen-progress incident (B1).

simulation.description: Provoked failure scenarios are labelled simulation (P6).
